title: Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC): Benchmarking Synthetic Evals

steps.prompt: Before deploying an updated agent prompt or action schema to production, how do architects verify that new changes have not caused regressions on existing capabilities?

options.label: Execute automated evaluation suites against golden benchmark test datasets, scoring tool fidelity and guardrails
options.rationale: The Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) mandates automated evaluation suites against fixed benchmark test cases to mathematically measure drift and regression before deployment.

options.label: Conduct spot manual testing in a developer sandbox across five representative prompt variations before deployment
options.distractorAntipattern: Manual spot testing lacks statistical rigor, coverage, and repeatability across non-deterministic LLM outputs.
options.rationale: Ad-hoc manual testing lacks coverage, repeatability, and statistical confidence, failing to detect subtle regressions in agent planning or tool selection.

options.label: Deploy changes directly to production behind a feature flag and monitor agent error logs over the first 24 hours
options.distractorAntipattern: Testing in production without automated benchmark evals exposes live end-users to hallucinations and broken actions.
options.rationale: Relying on production user monitoring instead of pre-deployment benchmark evaluations introduces immense business risk and unvetted agent hallucinations.
